picks.editorial_note: A Nature-published study shows AI can design novel physics experiments that outperform human-designed setups — a genuine breakthrough in using AI as a scientific collaborator rather than just a tool.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's framework trains LLMs to express calibrated uncertainty when proposing experiments, a meaningful advance for making AI-driven scientific discovery more trustworthy and efficient.
picks.title: An AI capable of doubt can optimize scientific discovery

picks.title: Funding cuts hit research focused on making American healthcare safer, more efficient
